# Dublin PropTech

> Dublin PropTech is a property services company in Dublin, Ireland. It carries out independent snagging inspections of new build homes and supplies and fits flooring (laminate, carpets, tiles, LVT, engineered wood), stair cladding, wall panels and made-to-measure blinds.

Contact: +353 89 965 5102 · dublinproptech@gmail.com · https://dublinproptech.com/service/contact
Areas served: Dublin, Kildare, Westmeath, Drogheda (Co. Louth). Other locations on request.

## Snagging inspections
- [Snagging inspections Dublin](https://dublinproptech.com/service/snaglist): 300+ point check, thermal imaging, photographic developer-ready report within 48 hours. Fixed prices: 1–2 bed €200, 3 bed €250, 4 bed €300, re-inspection €150.

## Flooring and interiors
- [Flooring supply & fit](https://dublinproptech.com/service/flooring): all flooring categories, subfloor preparation, skirting, trims and thresholds.
- [Laminate flooring](https://dublinproptech.com/service/flooring/laminate): AC5 laminate, 8–14mm, herringbone, waterproof 12mm range.
- [Carpets & carpet tiles](https://dublinproptech.com/service/flooring/carpets): luxury deep-pile carpets and Tarkett DESSO Essence carpet tiles.
- [Floor tiles](https://dublinproptech.com/service/flooring/tiles): porcelain, ceramic and large-format tile supply and fitting.
- [Engineered wood flooring](https://dublinproptech.com/service/flooring/engineered-wood)
- [Herringbone & chevron flooring](https://dublinproptech.com/service/flooring/herringbone)
- [LVT, SPC & porcelain tiles](https://dublinproptech.com/service/lvt)
- [Stair cladding & carpet runners](https://dublinproptech.com/service/stairs)
- [Wall panels & waterproof shower panels](https://dublinproptech.com/service/wall-panels)
- [Made-to-measure blinds](https://dublinproptech.com/service/blinds)
